ambient_location_known_id.note: Static scene/travel location references only. Do not infer mutable inventory, staff, finances, security, damage, schedule, availability, ownership changes, or process state from this catalog; persistent mechanical state belongs in registered mutable authority.

strategic_place_known_id.note: Known place.* ID -> use owner prefix shard state/index/owners/place.json, then load only the exact state/place owner. Ambient ontology never substitutes for strategic mutable state.

population_recruitment.note: Recruitment is aggregate for mass forces. Sword Manor preserves every accepted member as a stable core in one bounded roster while shared capability remains cohort-hosted.

mission_runtime_known_id.note: Known stable mission ID resolves one executable mission owner. Mission creation still requires verified issuer, participant, timing, and institutional authority; a typed gameplay command may mutate only an existing owner.
